text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They are finally entering the third 
corner! Who will make the first move from 
here?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! The winner of the Arima 
Kinen is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even before the frustration... I'm just so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Teio ran...! It was... truly 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! Teio came back, just like she 
said she would...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot remain in such an 
embarrassing state forever, either—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Next time, I'll be the one to win, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, next time, I will be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what what what is going on—!? 
Nature, and Tannhauser too!? Hey, you're 
kinda heavy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, just let me celebrate properly for 
once today! Welcome back!

And so, Tokai Teio's comeback race, the 
Arima Kinen, came to an end.

Though she had missed out on victory, 
Ikuno Dictus's expression was one of deep 
fulfillment—
